title: 最短补全词
summary: 从单词列表中找最短单词，使其忽略大小写后包含车牌中所有字母及相应重复次数；并列取列表中最早者。
insight: 先统计车牌所需的 26 个字母频次，再逐词统计并检查是否逐项覆盖；只在严格更短时更新。
pitfalls: 车牌中的数字和空格忽略
字母比较不区分大小写
重复字母需求必须满足次数

solutions.title: 字符频次覆盖检查
solutions.idea: 把车牌约束压缩为固定 26 维计数。
steps: 统计 licensePlate 中英文字母的小写频次 required
对每个 word 统计 available
若所有 available[i]>=required[i] 且长度严格更短则更新；返回结果

code.java: class Solution { public String shortestCompletingWord(String licensePlate,String[] words){int[] required=count(licensePlate);String answer=null;for(String word:words)if((answer==null||word.length()<answer.length())&&covers(count(word),required))answer=word;return answer;}private int[] count(String value){int[] counts=new int[26];for(char raw:value.toCharArray()){char c=Character.toLowerCase(raw);if(c>='a'&&c<='z')counts[c-'a']++;}return counts;}private boolean covers(int[] available,int[] required){for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(available[i]<required[i])return false;return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun shortestCompletingWord(licensePlate:String,words:Array<String>):String{val required=count(licensePlate);var answer:String?=null;for(word in words)if((answer==null||word.length<answer!!.length)&&covers(count(word),required))answer=word;return answer!!};private fun count(value:String):IntArray{val counts=IntArray(26);for(raw in value){val c=raw.lowercaseChar();if(c in 'a'..'z')counts[c-'a']++};return counts};private fun covers(available:IntArray,required:IntArray)=available.indices.all{available[it]>=required[it]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { array<int,26> count(string value){array<int,26> counts{};for(char raw:value){char c=tolower((unsigned char)raw);if(c>='a'&&c<='z')++counts[c-'a'];}return counts;}bool covers(array<int,26>& available,array<int,26>& required){for(int i=0;i<26;++i)if(available[i]<required[i])return false;return true;}public:string shortestCompletingWord(string licensePlate,vector<string>& words){auto required=count(licensePlate);string answer;for(string& word:words){auto available=count(word);if((answer.empty()||word.size()<answer.size())&&covers(available,required))answer=word;}return answer;} };
